const date =  $state.context.REQUEST.ACTION = "SYNC_ONE" ? "1970" : $state.context.REQUEST?.DATA?.model?.lastTransactionAt ?? "1970";
const ftime = $moment(date).format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss Z');
const top = $state?.context?.REQUEST?.DATA?.sql?.increment ?? 0;
const id = $state?.context?.REQUEST?.DATA?.sql?.id ?? 99999999999999999999999;
return `
SELECT
    r.*,
    s.*,
    b.*,
    ab.assembly,
    e.laborresources,
    e.machineresources
  
  FROM
  (
     SELECT
      TOP ${top}
      br.id as revision,
      br.effectivestartdate,
      br.effectiveenddate,
      br.name,
      br.billofmaterials bom,
      br.createddate,
      br.isinactive r_inactive,
      br.lastmodifieddate,
      bm.isinactive bom_inactive,
      bm.legacybomforassembly
    FROM bomrevision br 
    JOIN bom bm ON br.billofmaterials = bm.id
    WHERE 
      br.id > ${id} 
    AND  (
      br.lastmodifieddate >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('${ftime}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM')    
      OR (
        br.lastmodifieddate IS NULL 
        AND
        br.createddate >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('${ftime}','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM')   
      )
    )
   
    ORDER BY br.id
  ) b
  JOIN assemblyitembom ab
    ON b.bom = ab.billofmaterials
  JOIN manufacturingrouting r
    ON b.bom = r.billofmaterials
JOIN manufacturingroutingroutingstep s 
ON s.manufacturingrouting = r.id
JOIN entitygroup e on e.id=s.manufacturingworkcenter 
`

const date =  $state.context.REQUEST.ACTION = "SYNC_ONE" ? "1970" : $state.context.REQUEST?.DATA?.model?.lastTransactionAt ?? "1970";
const ftime = $moment(date).format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss Z');
const top = $state?.context?.REQUEST?.DATA?.sql?.increment ?? 0;
const id = $state?.context?.REQUEST?.DATA?.sql?.id ?? 99999999999999999999999;
  
return `
  SELECT
    b.billofmaterials AS bom,
    ab.*,
    c.*,
    i.itemtype
  FROM
    (
    SELECT TOP ${top}
      br.billofmaterials,
      br.id
    FROM bomrevision br 
    WHERE 
      br.id in (${[...new Set($state.context.LOCAL?.routing?.map(v=>v.revision))].join(",")})
    ORDER BY br.id
    ) b
  JOIN assemblyitembom ab 
    ON ab.billofmaterials=b.billofmaterials
  JOIN manufacturingroutingcomponent c 
    ON c.revision = b.id
  JOIN item i ON c.item=i.id
  WHERE i.itemtype in ('InvtPart', 'Assembly')
    AND c.operationsequencenumber IS NOT NULL
`

SELECT
  br.effectivestartdate, 
  br.effectiveenddate,
  br.id revId,
  br.isinactive revIsInactive,
  br.lastmodifieddate revLastModifiedDate,
  br.memo revMemo,
  br.name revName,
  bom.*,
  c.id componentId,
  c.bomquantity,
  c.componentyield,
  c.description,
  c.isoutsourcingcharge,
  c.item,
  c.itemsource,
  c.quantity,
  c.units,
  i.itemtype
FROM (
  SELECT 
    TOP 100
    *
  FROM bomrevision
  WHERE 
    isinactive='F'
    and
    id > ?
     AND  (
      lastmodifieddate >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(?,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM')    
      OR (
        lastmodifieddate IS NULL 
        AND
        createddate >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(?,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM')   
      )
    )
  ORDER BY id
) br 
JOIN (
  SELECT * FROM bomassembly ba 
  JOIN bom b 
    ON ba.billofmaterials = b.id
) bom 
  ON br.billofmaterials = bom.id 
LEFT JOIN bomrevisioncomponent c 
  ON br.id = c.bomrevision  
LEFT JOIN item i on c.item = i.id
where i.itemtype in ('Assembly', 'InvtPart', 'NonInvtPart', 'OthCharge')
ORDER BY bom.id

SELECT
  br.effectivestartdate, 
  br.effectiveenddate,
  br.id revId,
  br.isinactive revIsInactive,
  br.lastmodifieddate revLastModifiedDate,
  br.memo revMemo,
  br.name revName,
  bom.*,
  c.id componentId,
  c.bomquantity,
  c.componentyield,
  c.description,
  c.isoutsourcingcharge,
  c.item,
  c.itemsource,
  c.quantity,
  c.units,
  i.itemtype
FROM (
  SELECT 
    TOP 100
    *
  FROM bomrevision
  WHERE 
    isinactive='F'
    and
    id > ?
     AND  (
      lastmodifieddate >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(?,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM')    
      OR (
        lastmodifieddate IS NULL 
        AND
        createddate >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(?,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM')   
      )
    )
  ORDER BY id
) br 
JOIN (
  SELECT * FROM bomassembly ba 
  JOIN bom b 
    ON ba.billofmaterials = b.id
) bom 
  ON br.billofmaterials = bom.id 
LEFT JOIN bomrevisioncomponent c 
  ON br.id = c.bomrevision  
LEFT JOIN item i on c.item = i.id
where i.itemtype in ('Assembly', 'InvtPart', 'NonInvtPart', 'OthCharge')
ORDER BY bom.id
